In a stunning show of comradery, Dwarves and Elves make contact and establish a trade system for knowledge, sharing the secrets of technology and magic with one another and beginning a massive leap in society. This leads to a time often called a renaissance or “Second Golden Age”. Elves learn from the mistakes of their forefathers and become the stewards of the world, seeking to maintain order and balance in society and nature against evil.
